question: Which of the following states has launched the 'Mo Ghara' or 'My Home' scheme, with an aim to transform kutcha houses into pucca ones?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odisha** has launched the 'Mo Ghara' or 'My Home' scheme.
 
• The aim of the scheme is to transform **kutcha houses into pucca ones**.
 
• This initiative is part of the state's efforts to improve housing conditions for its residents.
 
• Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries will receive financial assistance to upgrade their homes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **state government** has allocated funds specifically for the implementation of the 'Mo Ghara' scheme.
 
• This initiative is expected to benefit a large number of families living in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
• By converting kutcha houses into pucca ones, the scheme aims to provide **better living conditions** and enhance the quality of life for the residents.
 
• Similar housing schemes have been launched in other states as well, reflecting a nationwide effort to improve housing infrastructure.
